longTitle.officialTitle: To authorize Pacific Historic Parks to establish a commemorative display to honor members of the United States Armed Forces who served in the Pacific Theater of World War II, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Admiral Lloyd R. ‘Joe’ Vasey Pacific War Commemorative Display Establishment Act”.

paragraph.heading: Association.—
paragraph.chapeau: The term “Association” means Pacific Historic Parks, a corporation that is—

subparagraph.content: a cooperating association with the National Park Service;
organized under the laws of the State of Hawaii; and
described in section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 and exempt from taxation under section 501(a) of that Code.

paragraph.heading: Director.—
paragraph.content: The term “Director” means the Director of the National Park Service.

paragraph.heading: Commemorative display.—
paragraph.content: The term “commemorative display” means the Pacific Theater of World War II Commemorative Display authorized to be established under section 4(a).

section.heading: PURPOSES.
section.chapeau: The purposes of this Act are to—

paragraph.content: honor the brave members of the United States Armed Forces who fought on behalf of the United States of America in the Pacific Theater during World War II;
provide a place to mourn the more than 150,000 American and allied lives lost in the Pacific Theater during World War II; and
educate the public about United States battles in the Pacific Theater and its role in World War II.

subsection.heading: Authorization To Establish Commemorative Display.—
subsection.content: The Association may establish and maintain a commemorative display to honor the members of the United States Armed Forces and Allies who served in the Pacific Theater during World War II.

subsection.heading: Use of Federal Funds Prohibited.—
subsection.content: Federal funds may not be used to design, procure, prepare, install, or maintain the commemorative display, but the Director may accept and expend contributions of non-Federal funds and resources for such purposes.

paragraph.heading: In general.—
paragraph.content: The Director may allow the commemorative display to be established at a suitable location at the Pearl Harbor site of the World War II Valor in the Pacific National Monument in Honolulu, Hawaii.

paragraph.heading: Condition.—
paragraph.content: The commemorative display may not be established at any location under the jurisdiction of the Director until the Director determines that an assured source of non-Federal funding has been established for the design, procurement, installation, and maintenance of the commemorative display.

subsection.heading: Design of the Commemorative Display.—
subsection.content: The final design of the commemorative display shall be subject to the approval of the Director.
